summary: Phase C is complete: none of the 20 movement changes HELPED. The hidden-information scorekeeper fell from PROMISING on three seeds to NO REAL DIFFERENCE on five (86.24% ± 5.05 points), so no movement trick qualifies for stacking. Plain movement remains the best confirmed eligible normal-condition baseline at 83.36% ± 2.99 points on development seeds. In mixed conditions, plain movement HELPED in all three splits and plain aim HELPED in mostly-fixed and even splits, but the aim guesses did not become more accurate. No normal-condition aim repair worked. Fresh confirmation remains locked, and the original 80.2% headline is unchanged.
